title: The Zone of Interest & the Soundscape of Hell

commenti.body: I really liked Zone of Interest, and thought the use of sound and the camera placements were so thoughtfully executed in terms of building atmosphere and delivering information in surprising ways. I’m excited to read this essay!

I'm quietly looking forward to watch the movie again. It's tough but packed with so many little details theres no way I picked up on everything the first viewing. A lot of it played like a horror movie and the whole thing felt very creative and inventive.
